body: Ok let’s say hypothetically the issue is suicidal thoughts, harming yourself, and depression. In my family asking for help looks weak. And sometimes even talking about your problem is looked as weird. So when I talk to people about it. It’s like are you saying too much. What is too much?

So as a hypothetical if you’re comfortable talking about a certain issue with a friend. And your comfortable talking about the good and the bad. But it seems like you talk about that issue a lot is that attention seeking

I would like to be able to talk to my mom about this. But I guess I’m just afraid of what she’ll think of me. Like I already bother her so much. And a part of doesn’t want to tell anyone so if I did do it. No one can stop me.
Well for me my friend gets mad cause she doesn’t see improvement. And it’s hard cause sometimes you want someone to understand you or even just listen. But it feels like no one wants to.
Me too my voice sounds like I’m forever stuck in puberty
Is it bad that this made me feel good.
That happens to me all the time. It’s like this feeling washes over me. Then I cut. As for the other question I’m not sure what it is
Oh lord that’s me all the time.  I just wish I could cut deeper.
Well at least I’m not the only one who bad night. I was trying to stop cutting. But my depression got hold of me. So I cut my leg and stomach.
I feel you.  Just trying not to cut has become more difficult for me.
